summary: Polyrizon Ltd., an Israeli medical device company, filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board approved the appointment of Mr. Ami Oren as a Class I director effective May 14, 2026. The filing describes Mr. Oren's background as an entrepreneur with over 20 years of experience, including founding a food business which he sold. No abrupt departure, forced change or prior vacancy is noted; the appointment appears routine. No terms, consideration, or advisors are mentioned. As a non-US issuer, this Form 6-K serves in lieu of a US proxy disclosure. Watch for any future governance shifts or board restructuring.
